Assignment Title: Tree Map – Patient

Assignment Question:
The application relies on a Patient class which serves as the key in a Java TreeMap. The Patient class contains three data members: a String patientId, an int urgencyScore (ranging from low to high clinical urgency), and an int minutesWaiting (the elapsed time since arrival). It includes a constructor to initialize these values, standard getter methods (getPatientId(), getUrgencyScore(), getMinutesWaiting()), a method named getPriorityIndex() which computes the sorting priority by multiplying urgencyScore by minutesWaiting, and a compareTo(Patient other) method. The compareTo method must sort patients in descending order of their calculated priorityIndex. If two patients have identical priority indices, they must be sorted alphabetically by their patientId.
 Input Validation Conditions
 Before registering any patient into the triage system, the inputs must satisfy all of the following conditions within a single compound check:
·      The patientId must consist of exactly four digits (e.g., "1024").
·      The urgencyScore must be an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
·      The minutesWaiting must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.
 Input Format:
 ·      The first line contains an integer representing the total number of patients to process.
·      For each patient, a single line contains three values separated by spaces: patientId (String), urgencyScore (int), and minutesWaiting (int).
 
Output Format:
·       If any input fails validation, the program must immediately print "Invalid Input" and terminate.
·       If all inputs are valid, the program prints the sorted contents of the TreeMap, with each patient's details on a new line, formatted exactly as: patientId priorityIndex
Sample Input
3
1001 5 10
1002 8 15
1003 4 20
Sample Output
1002 120
1003 80
1001 50
